en: {fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You, human? You decided that...! I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Guess I gotta thank you. For staying like this... and for making me a hero, too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I thought being a hero was nothing but a pain... but I was wrong. I figured out a lot of things.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Like what really matters. You're the one who taught me that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thanks. I'm really glad I met you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You'll stay by my side from now on, right? Always... Stay with me always...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}H-hey... what's that mean? You're going back to Heaven!? Hold on, you promised, didn't you!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I thought you'd stay by my side, and now you're leaving? Is there nothing I can do?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I see... No matter how hard I fight it, it's no use, huh. But I'll say it anyway...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I wanted you to stay here! I thought this time I'd be the one protecting you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're really going... You're an angel, so there's no helping it...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Fine... Go! Just go! See ya!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}So there's peace now... Still can't believe I really pulled it off, though...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You're the one who showed me even a guy like me can do it if he tries. ...Thanks...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh yeah, you're gonna be human, right? You're a weird one, all right. That's just like you. Well, if we run into each other, we run into each other. I'll be waiting.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh, so you're going back after all. It's kinda lonely, but there's no helping it, right? You're an angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}But before we part, there's something I wanna say... Look... thanks...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}'Cause I figure I only got this far thanks to you... See ya. I won't forget you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You're becoming human, Angel? Really!? I see... I'm so glad...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Oh, I'm sorry... But I'm truly happy. We can be together from now on, can't we?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}On our journey together, Angel, I learned how important it is to face things instead of running away.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I was running away by singing. But not anymore. I've learned what really matters...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I want to sing for everyone from the heart. And I want to keep traveling with you... forever...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}That's all right, isn't it? ...Please stay with me always.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}What! You're going back!? But what about our promise...? Is there really nothing to be done?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I see... I don't know how it came to this, but this is goodbye, isn't it...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}To me, Angel, you were irreplaceable.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You were the one who gave me the courage to stand up to the strong... And... that promise...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}No... I understand... Goodbye, Angel. But I won't forget you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even if we can never meet, I'll keep singing for you... Goodbye...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I won this peace with my own hands, didn't I, Angel... I still can't believe it...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you so much. I learned so much courage from you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Still, you're becoming human, Angel... But maybe that's just like you. I pray we meet again someday.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So you're finally going back. I'm a little lonely... but you're an angel, so it can't be helped, can it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I can never thank you enough, Angel. Thank you so much. You're the one who gave me courage...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I'll never forget you, Angel. I'll make our meeting into a song and keep singing it always...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You'll become human. Thank you for keeping your promise... I'm glad... truly...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Isn't it a very hard decision for an angel to become human? And yet you chose it...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Truly... I have no words to thank you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you hadn't appeared before me, who knows what would have become of me by now...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Touched by your kindness, I was able to set out on the right path again.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you... And please, stay with me forever.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You're returning to Heaven? Is that true? That promise... those words... are you saying they were lies...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I can't believe it... from you, an angel... Or is there some reason behind it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even so... I may never be able to forgive you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm truly grateful for everything until now. But just when peace has finally come and we could stay together...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}All I did for your sake was for nothing, then, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Goodbye... Please, disappear from my sight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Peace has finally returned. I still can't believe I seized it with my own hands...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Now I have the confidence to keep walking the right path. Angel, I truly thank you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}By the way, I hear you're becoming human? If you ever need my help, come anytime. I'll be waiting.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If peace has returned, then this is farewell... It's a shame, but it means your strength has been recognized.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I never thought I could do this much on my own... It's all thanks to you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you... You're a precious memory. I'll never forget you. Farewell, and be well...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Really!? You're becoming human! Yaaay!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I caused you lots of trouble, so now I want to pay you back lots.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You picked me to be a hero, and while we traveled all over, I learned lots of things...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Like what being really strong means. I still can't beat Dad, but I'll try even harder!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}'Cause you'll be right beside me, right? I'll get even, even stronger!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Thank you so much!! We'll be together forever and ever. Okay? It's a promise!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}What? You're kidding, right? You're not really going home, are you!? You're lying, right!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You promised that time that you'd stay with me!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I can't believe an angel would lie!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I kept trying my best 'cause I thought we'd be together once there was peace...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You... you... just go away!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Peace is finally back. Hee hee, I'm happy, super happy! 'Cause I'm the one who beat them!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}But I think I got that strong thanks to you, Angel. Thank you so much!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You're gonna be human, right, Angel? Then come to my house sometime! I want to make you a big feast.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Peace is finally back. But you're going home to Heaven, right, Angel? I knew it, but I'm sad...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}'Cause I got strong enough to beat Gaap thanks to you, Angel. Thank you so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}We can't ever see each other again, right? But I'll never forget you! So think of me sometimes too, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}{name:0080}, you're becoming human!? Really? All right! But are you sure? Really...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I mean, won't it be hard on you once you're human, {name:0080}? Even so... no...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You'll be fine for sure. After all, you taught me what a person can do...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you... for choosing what might be a hard road. But don't worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Just like I fought to protect the world, now I'll protect you, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I see... we'll be together from now on. But being like this all over again, it's kind of embarrassing...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You're kidding!? You promised that time!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That once the world was at peace, you'd stay with me!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But it didn't work out? I see... I really thought I could be with you forever, {name:0080}...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I wanted to pay you back so much, but now there's nothing I can do... I'm kind of let down...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The reason I kept going was because you were there, {name:0080}. But I'll give up.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Living in a world without you will be harder than ever, {name:0080}, but I'll manage somehow... See you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}
